items.title: Bob Schulz interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I used to sing like Louis, because I always loved Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Do you ever have them scat or anything like that?

Yeah, I used to. In fact I used to sing like Louis, because I always loved Louis Armstrong. And you can hear the gravel in my voice here. And that gravel is there because I used to do that too much and I was hemorrhaging my vocal chords and the doctor, you know he says, “What are you doing.” I says, “I’m doing this.” And he says, “Don’t do that.” I said okay. So I didn’t do that anymore.
